description: facebook: Profile Posts. GET /v1/facebook/profile/posts. Get a public Facebook page's timeline posts, 3 per page, newest first, as a signed-out visitor sees them: id, text, url, author, reactionCount, commentCount, shareCount, publishTime, and SD/HD video URLs with a thumbnail for videos and reels. Provide url or pageId (the id from /v1/facebook/profile). topComments is always empty and videoViewCount is null: the signed-out feed does not carry them. Pass cursor from a res Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to get the next 3 posts

pageId.description: The page's numeric id (id from /v1/facebook/profile). Saves reading the page first.

url.description: The URL of the public Facebook page

name: facebook_profile_posts
